title: Three Seers with Globe
description: Three women with elaborate face tattoos sit side by side on ornate purple chairs, collectively holding a large globe. The woman in the center wears a purple patterned dress while the others wear black and brown attire. Above them, a vibrant psychedelic rainbow wave flows across the composition, surrounded by floating globes, stylized eyes, silhouetted figures, and surreal plant-like forms against a bright yellow background.
